messages:
maria: FYI the infra-tools container build is failing CI on main — SBOM generation step errors out with a syft panic after the base image was updated upstream. Seen in two pipeline runs.

maria: Error snippet from the job log:
```
panic: runtime error: index out of range
at github.com/anchore/syft/pkg/sbom/.*
syft: failed to catalog image
Step: generate sbom
```

maria: This started after we bumped `infra-builder-base:latest` in the infra-tools repo. I suspect some distro layout change in the base image broke syft’s cataloger.

kevin: ugh. can you paste the full job link? I want to see the exact base digest the job pulled.

maria: https://buildkite.company/infra-tools/2345#job-12
The job pulled `ghcr.io/redwood/infra-builder-base@sha256:6f8a...c3e` and also tried `:latest` fallback. We should stop relying on `:latest`.

kevin: agree. immediate remediation: re-publish a pinned builder image that matches the previous known-good digest and point the pipeline to that digest. quick commands to retag & push if you have the digest locally:
```
docker pull ghcr.io/redwood/infra-builder-base@sha256:6f8a...
docker tag ghcr.io/redwood/infra-builder-base@sha256:6f8a... ghcr.io/redwood/infra-builder-base:ci-stable
docker push ghcr.io/redwood/infra-builder-base:ci-stable
```
That lets CI finish while we investigate syft failure.

sasha: Long-term fixes we discussed previously:
- Always pin base images in Dockerfiles by digest (use `FROM ghcr.io/...@sha256:...`).
- Generate SBOMs inside the build and upload to our artifact store (nexus/s3) with a stable name per digest.
- Require `cosign` signatures for builder images and record provenance (rekor + cosign attest).

sasha: Also we should fail builds if the SBOM tool returns a non-empty set of policy violations. Add a `assert-sbom` step that compares current SBOM to a baseline for infra-tools.

maria: +1. I can send a small PR to the infra-tools pipeline to stop using `:latest` and switch to `image_digest` env var consumed by `buildkite-docker-publish`.

rohit: we should automate pin updates. manual edits cause drift and slowdowns. Suggest: use renovate or a custom GH Action that updates `FROM` digests when base images are promoted. Also, integrate a promotion workflow that only promotes a base image to `latest` after it passes our nightly GPU toolchain tests (those run on dedicated infra nodes).

rohit: cost note: the nightly GPU runs are expensive; propose we only run full GPU compatibility matrix on new builder base publishes, otherwise run lighter smoke tests. saves ~200 GPU hours / month.

infra-ci-bot: job #2345 — sbom-step — failed
logs: https://buildkite.company/infra-tools/2345/12/annotations

kevin: for the SBOM generation step, switch to `syft package -o cyclonedx-json` and store that output. Also consider `grype` policy checks if we want vulnerability gating.

kevin: example buildx + syft flow we can add to the pipeline:
```
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
  --cache-from=type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/redwood/infra-builder-cache:latest \
  --pull -t ghcr.io/redwood/infra-tools:${BUILDKITE_COMMIT} .

# after pushing image to registry
syft ghcr.io/redwood/infra-tools@sha256:... -o cyclonedx-json > sbom-${DIGEST}.json
aws s3 cp sbom-${DIGEST}.json s3://redwood-sbom/infra-tools/${DIGEST}.json
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/_/secrets/cosign-key ghcr.io/redwood/infra-tools@sha256:...
```

sasha: also update Helm charts and Terraform references. Helm values should accept `image.digest` in addition to `image.tag`. For Terraform modules that set image tags, switch to pulling digest via data source or update the module to accept `image_digest` as an explicit variable.

maria: can someone own the immediate fix (retag/push) and someone else own the CI change? I can do the pipeline PR but won't have access to ghcr permissions to push retag.

kevin: I can retag and push the `ci-stable` tag now, and open a short-lived deployment to test. After that, maria please open the PR to require `image_digest` in Buildkite.

rohit: I'll open a ticket to wire renovate to update FROM digests and to add an image promotion flow. will include the cost optimization for GPU test scheduling.

sasha: I'll draft the SBOM + cosign enforcement step and add a snippet for `assert-sbom` that compares against previous SBOM by digest and fails on unexpected new packages.

maria: thanks. action items:
- kevin: retag & push ci-stable (in progress)
- maria: PR to use explicit `image_digest` env and bump pipeline step to use digest
- sasha: PR with `assert-sbom` and cosign integration
- rohit: ticket for renovate + promotion automation + test scheduling

maria: pinging owners here so we can close the incident once CI passes. :thumbsup:
